checks.native_kinds: Local and synthetic cloud create/update/archive for category, project, section, label, goal and saved task view
checks.preservation: Exact task journal serialization and native relationships retained; organization history separate; zero game effects
checks.recovery: Original request after lost preview, original receipt after unknown acceptance, accepted-preview retry without another acceptance, exact stale/expiry references
checks.isolation: Account/sign-out re-entry retains only owner pending state; late preview/acceptance and changed-cloud responses discarded; original access required
checks.failure_controls: No-op and invalid refs refused; frozen/cloud-owned browser writes refused; failed refresh blocks editing; forged effect receipts refused; transport and caller cancellation preserve uncertain original
checks.diagnostics: Correct cloud-read mode and unknown missing receipt; exact safe saved context; no private names, raw transport messages or account selector
checks.documentation: Changed prose and index/navigation pass; historical audit warning only

limitations: No new organization editor markup or rendered UI qualification in this controller unit. Consumer page integration is a separate required task.
No deployment, real enrollment, live organization mutation, party mutation or device qualification.

Deadline/caller fencing is implemented at the controller wait boundary; a truly noncooperative external transport cannot be forcibly stopped by browser code. Existing HTTP cancellation remains separate from confirmed server outcome.
